The Mantra, 26-28 Whitmore Street, Edgeware, Christchurch, New Zealand.
Seventeen garden homes around a car-free 3 m green walk, a 6 m commons lawn, a productive vegetable garden and a low rain garden: ten three-level two-bedroom townhouses, four two-level three-bedroom homes, two coachhouse homes on levels 2 and 3 above open garden passages, and a retained two-level classical eastern house. Rooftop solar, ten parks including two EV bays, a 41.8 m2 cycle hub.
Concept design (Whitmore Village Rev E, Aventa), not yet consented. Marketed by Angela Webb, Bayleys Christchurch, +64 27 349 1997.
